column1: #WITH base AS (SELECT DISTINCT observation_id, sso_name FROM sso.screening_nuv_initial WHERE decision IN ('Y','D')) SELECT x.observation_id, x.sso_name, x.ra_deg_1, x.dec_deg_1, x.ra_deg_2, x.dec_deg_2, x."filter", x.xmatch_type, x.v_mag_1, x.v_mag_1_corrected, x.mlim_obs FROM base b JOIN sso.xmm_om_unique x ON x.observation_id = b.observation_id AND x.sso_name = b.sso_name WHERE x."filter" = 'V'
